pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

3. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

4. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

6. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.

7. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.

8. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.

9. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.

10. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

11. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language School.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

13. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed

14. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

15. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
